offering_description.value: Operates regulated water and wastewater utilities that treat, deliver and bill for drinking water and sewer service. Serves residential, commercial and government customers in several US states, mainly through pipe networks and treatment plants.

primary_services.value: water distribution; wastewater collection; customer billing; contract operations; infrastructure replacement

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential households receiving water and sewer service; B2B: commercial and industrial water users; B2G: municipalities and public authorities served under contracts

end_markets.value: residential water; commercial and industrial users; municipal utilities

revenue_model.value: service fees: metered water and sewer service charges paid by customers; other: infrastructure surcharges and municipal contract operations

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs water treatment plants and pipe networks, selling service to end customers; service provider: operates wastewater systems under contract for municipalities

geography_served.value: US regional: Pennsylvania, Ohio, Illinois, Texas, New Jersey, North Carolina, Virginia, Indiana, Kentucky and Florida

specialization.value: niche specialist: water and wastewater utility service only

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct billing of residential and business customers in its service areas; other: municipal contracts awarded by local governments

regulatory_exposure.value: high: regulated water and sewer utility rates and service approved by state public utility commissions, drinking water rules under the federal Safe Drinking Water Act
